description: Atlas Impala Mk I two-seat trainer on display at Queen's Fort. Serial 591 is given by the saairforce.co.za places directory and by aviationmuseum.eu's Queen's Fort page. A 2009 Impala survivors compilation instead lists 589 as a SAAF Museum aircraft on display and does not place 591 at Bloemfontein, so there is a 589/591 digit conflict that one telephone call to the museum would settle. A 2006 stock photograph confirms an Impala Mk I displayed at the fort.

Atlas Impala Mk II on display at Queen's Fort. Serial 1032 is corroborated by two independent lineages: the aviationmuseum.eu and saairforce.co.za directory entries, and a 2009 Impala survivors compilation which records 1032 as SAAF Museum property on display at Fort Bloemfontein with build number 33.

Dassault Mirage IIIRZ reconnaissance fighter, serial 837, at Queen's Fort. Only four RZs were delivered to the SAAF, numbers 835 to 838, so 837 is a plausible and scarce airframe. aviationmuseum.eu lists it as on display; the older saairforce.co.za directory described it as under restoration at the fort. Recorded as on_display with that earlier restoration note flagged.
